label.purpose: Measurements, timestamps, and structural metadata only.

motion.name: view-in
motion.purpose: A short lift when switching between static mock views.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Preserve readable state changes for reduced-motion users.

narrative.overview: Calories treats the current day as a work surface rather than a dashboard. The interface is a quiet, precise instrument for recording food, reading data quality, and choosing what to trust.
keyCharacteristics: Five-destination mobile rail with centered Add Food

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Ultraviolet is a commit signal, not decoration.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Mono is for data and orientation, never for decorative technical flavor.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: A surface earns depth by changing tone or state, not by floating on a generic shadow.

dos: Do keep the current day and next action visible.
Do keep source and uncertainty adjacent to data.
Do preserve touch targets and visible focus.
donts: Don't use gradients, glossy glass, or decorative shadows.
Don't use color as the only status indicator.
Don't make uncertain data look confirmed.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: An ultraviolet commit action used for Add Food, Add to Log, and Save Meal.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:40px; padding:0 15px; border:1px solid #b8a3ff; border-radius:7px; color:#171129; background:#b8a3ff; font:600 13px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#d4c8ff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #b8a3ff; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A raised tonal action for secondary decisions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:40px; padding:0 15px; border:1px solid #465a7a; border-radius:7px; color:#cbd2e3; background:#1e2840; font:600 13px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:#617398; color:#eef0ff; background:#283650; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #b8a3ff; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A dark, bordered search field with mono shortcut affordance.
components.css: .ds-search { display:flex; align-items:center; min-height:42px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid #2c3954; border-radius:7px; color:#9aa4bb; background:#151c2d; font:13px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-search span { position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; overflow:hidden; clip:rect(0 0 0 0); } .ds-search input { min-width:0; flex:1; border:0; outline:0; color:#eef0ff; background:transparent; font:13px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color:#6f83bd; } .ds-search:focus-within input { outline:2px solid #b8a3ff; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A 44px rail item that becomes one of five bottom-navigation destinations on phones, including Daily Targets.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:0 11px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:7px; color:#9aa4bb; background:transparent; font:15px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-align:left; } .ds-nav-item-active { border-color:#39496b; color:#eef0ff; background:#18233c; } .ds-nav-item-active .icon { color:#b8a3ff; } .ds-nav-item small { margin-left:auto; color:#9585d1; font:10px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #b8a3ff; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Mobile Navigation
components.description: A fixed five-column phone rail with Log, Food Database, centered Add Food, Saved Foods, and Daily Targets.
components.css: .mobile-nav { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); min-height:70px; padding:7px 9px max(7px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); border-top:1px solid #465a7a; background:#0f1626; } .mobile-nav-item { min-height:44px; color:#77839c; background:transparent; font:8px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .mobile-nav-item.is-active { color:#b8a3ff; background:#18233c; } .mobile-nav-item--add > span { width:36px; height:36px; border:1px solid #d4c8ff; border-radius:50%; color:#171129; background:#d4c8ff; }

components.name: Review Source Chip
components.description: A compact source and certainty label that keeps candidate status visible.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:20px; padding:0 6px; border:1px solid #6c5736; border-radius:4px; color:#e5bc73; background:transparent; font:600 8px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; }
